## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the research or maintenance problem and what this change does.

## Evidence and validation

Link the relevant experiment/report and list checks actually performed. For a
documentation-only change, report link and diff checks. Distinguish software
tests, full benchmark results and official leaderboard acceptance.

## Provenance and limitations

Identify affected routes, revisions, comparison conditions, negative findings
and unresolved limits. State whether frozen artifacts or result claims change.

## Publication check

- [ ] Existing evidence and third-party attribution are preserved.
- [ ] No secrets, private coordination records or benchmark payloads are included.
- [ ] New score claims link to a complete record with denominator and failure handling, or this change makes no new score claim.
